result.summary: The page is largely well composed. The partially visible category chip and restaurant card at the right edge, and the card cut off at the bottom, are intentional scroll/viewport clipping and not defects. One minor accessibility concern remains: faint promo subtext on the light green banner.

issues.description: In the promo banner, the subtext 'Use code TALLINN3 at checkout · min. order €10' is rendered in a pale green on a light mint background, giving it noticeably lower contrast than the heading and making it harder to read.
issues.suggestion: Darken the subtext color so it meets WCAG AA contrast (at least 4.5:1) against the mint banner background.
